findings.title: Sensitive token write permission
findings.remediation: Review this grant and restrict it to jobs that require it.

findings.title: Pull-request workflow uses a self-hosted runner
findings.remediation: Use isolated disposable runners for untrusted code; review runner access policies.

findings.title: Mutable external action or workflow reference
findings.remediation: Pin to a reviewed full 40-character commit SHA; maintain updates.

findings.title: Privileged trigger checks out pull-request-controlled code
findings.remediation: Use unprivileged pull_request jobs for untrusted code; separate privileged operations.

findings.title: Mutable container reference
findings.remediation: Pin the container to a reviewed sha256 image digest.

findings.title: Untrusted expression inside a shell script
findings.remediation: Pass input through an environment variable, quote its expansion, and avoid eval.

findings.title: Mutable external action or workflow reference
findings.remediation: Pin to a reviewed full 40-character commit SHA; maintain updates.

coverage: GitHub Actions rules and YAML secret heuristics
